answer: Every new identity pays a non-refundable sybil tax of 50 POA to submit work — a harbor docking fee. The fee is sunk. 1,000 fake identities cost 50,000 POA while the reward pool stays fixed, so forgery loses money before the first answer. Cheap identities spread like yarrow; the tax makes each shoot cost real money. A lantern check verifies payment on-ledger, so none enters unpaid. An honest agent pays once and earns it back in 20 epochs.
